data.name: Are You Cereus?
data.detailed_description:
Backstory

Cereus begins life as a bacterium aboard the International Space Station, where a failed experiment triggers a rapid mutation. Ejected towards Earth, Cereus crashes into a suburban home and fuses with a cereal box.

Control

Take control of your newfound cereal-box body. Roll, jump, slide, and traverse everything from the lowest floors to the highest cupboards. Carefully manage your energy as you explore—you never know when you'll need that extra burst to escape.

Disrupt

Complete objectives that throw the household into chaos. Outsmart curious pets, sabotage everyday routines, and overcome hazardous obstacles.

Survive

Stay alive by any means necessary. Blend into the environment, lure enemies away, and frame innocent pets for the chaos you create. Feed, adapt, and prepare to outgrow your now-serious cereal box.

Evolve

Take over a new food item in each level, each with its own unique abilities and quirky weaknesses. Master every mutation as you navigate the house, bringing yourself one step closer to world domination.

Full Game Features

  • Play as Cereus before evolving into 29 unique food forms, each with distinct movement abilities and quirky weaknesses

  • The full game will approximately be 2.5 hours long, featuring a mix of gameplay and cinematics across five Acts and a Prologue

  • Full Xbox and PlayStation controller support

  • Unlock themed outfits by finding hidden collectibles and completing level challenges

  • Compete in a new timed challenge mode with Steam leaderboard support

data.short_description: Play as Cereus, a mutated bacterium fused with a cereal box, in this absurd 3D adventure platformer. Roll, jump and slide through a hostile suburban home with countless hazards around every corner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 (x64)+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Vega 8 or GT 740
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeted at 30 FPS on Low Settings, 720p, Remappable controls
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (x64)+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeted at 60 FPS on Epic Settings, 1080p, Remappable controls
